name: Archer
fantasy: A red-hooded ranger with a carved recurve bow and his dire wolf at his side. Shoots on the move: fire arrows that burn through a line, frost volleys that chill, and a thunderstep that leaves a storm sigil behind him.

directions.name: Flame
directions.desc: Fire Arrow, burning wounds and the bow's weight; his wolf's fangs catch fire.

directions.name: Frost
directions.desc: Frost Volley, the chill that slows them and the hide that keeps him alive; his wolf howls the cold.

directions.name: Storm and Hunt
directions.desc: Thunderstep, lightning that leaps, and the wolf on the quarry.

skills.name: Fire Arrow
skills.desc: A burning arrow that tears through every enemy in a line for 130% weapon damage and sets them alight: they burn for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Frost Volley
skills.desc: Loose a flight of frost arrows into the sky: they rain on the cursor for over a second, hitting everything within 4 metres again and again and chilling them (40% slower); the ground stays frozen for a few seconds, slowing everything that stands in it or crosses it.

skills.name: Thunderstep
skills.desc: Backflip away from the pointer, driving a thunderstone into a gold storm sigil where you stood. A moment later it detonates: everything on it is stunned for 3 seconds and hurt, and lightning leaps on into the 3 nearest others beyond it.

skills.name: Spirit Beast
skills.desc: Your Spirit Beast hunts at your side from the start (and you run 10% faster with it). Command it: on an enemy it pounces and fights it, on open ground it holds there, on yourself it comes back. Each command rouses you both: +40% damage for 12 seconds.

skills.name: Scatter Shot
skills.desc: Loose five arrows in a fan: 55% weapon damage each. A foe close enough takes several.

skills.name: Glacial Shard
skills.desc: An arrow of ice that pierces every foe in a line for 110% weapon damage and chills them (40% slower) for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Blast Arrow
skills.desc: A fire arrow that bursts at the first foe it strikes or where its flight ends: 150% weapon damage to everything within 3.5 metres, setting them burning.

skills.name: Storm Shot
skills.desc: A charged arrow: 100% weapon damage to the first foe it strikes, then lightning leaps on to 4 more for 70%.

skills.name: Hunter's Mark
skills.desc: Mark the foe under the pointer for 8 seconds: it takes 35% more damage from everyone, and your wolf hunts it down.

skills.name: Arrow Storm
skills.desc: Loose a storm of arrows into the sky: for 1.5 seconds they rain on the cursor, striking everything within 4.5 metres six times for 32% weapon damage.

rites.name: Kindling
rites.text: Fire Arrow deals {dmg:pierce}% more damage.

rites.name: Heavy Draw
rites.text: Your bow shots deal {dmg:attack}% more damage.

rites.name: Pyre
rites.text: Burning from Fire Arrow lasts and hurts {burn_dmg}% more.

rites.name: Quick Nock
rites.text: +{ias}% attack speed.

rites.name: Ember Fangs
rites.text: Your wolf's bites set foes alight: {wolf_burn}% of each bite burns them every second for 3 seconds.

rites.name: Deadeye
rites.text: +{crit}% chance to land a critical hit.

rites.name: Split Arrow
rites.text: Every bow shot flies as three arrows (the outer two at half damage).

rites.name: Keen Eye
rites.text: +{dex} dexterity.

rites.name: Hailstorm
rites.text: Frost Volley covers {volley_size}% more ground.

rites.name: Rime
rites.text: Frost Volley's chill slows {chill_pct}% more.

rites.name: Hide Armour
rites.text: +{armor_pct}% defense.

rites.name: Winter Howl
rites.text: Your wolf's pounce chills everything within 3.5 metres of where it lands.

rites.name: Endless Rain
rites.text: Frost Volley recharges {cd:volley}% faster and costs {cost:volley}% less mana.

rites.name: Shatter
rites.text: Chilled enemies take 20% more damage from your arrows.

rites.name: Hunter's Vigor
rites.text: +{life_pct}% maximum life.

rites.name: Thunder Jaws
rites.text: Thunderstep's sigil deals {dmg:snare}% more damage and stuns {snare_dur} seconds longer.

rites.name: Forked Lightning
rites.text: Thunderstep's lightning leaps to {arc_count} more enemies.

rites.name: Spirit Bond
rites.text: Your wolf hits {dmg:beast}% harder.

rites.name: Aftershock
rites.text: Thunderstep's sigil strikes {snare_max} more time(s), a little weaker each time.

rites.name: Pack Hunter
rites.text: The hunt your commands rouse is {buff_pow}% stronger.

rites.name: Alpha
rites.text: A second wolf runs with you.

rites.name: Kindling
rites.text: Your burns deal +{burn_pct}% damage and last {burn_dur}% longer.

rites.name: Fire-Tipped
rites.text: Plain shots set what they strike burning ({pct}% of the hit a second).

rites.name: Wildfire
rites.text: A burning foe that dies sets everything within {r} m alight.

rites.name: Conflagration
rites.text: Burning foes take +{more}% damage from your hits.

rites.name: Phoenix Quiver
rites.text: Every {n}th plain shot looses a free Fire Arrow.

rites.name: Biting Cold
rites.text: Your chills last {chill_pct}% longer and slow more.

rites.name: Frostbite
rites.text: Chilled foes take +{more}% damage from your hits.

rites.name: Rimed Arrows
rites.text: Plain shots chill what they strike.

rites.name: Ice Shards
rites.text: A chilled foe that dies shatters: {pct}% weapon damage to everything within {r} m, chilling them.

rites.name: Absolute Zero
rites.text: Every {n}th hit on a chilled foe freezes it solid for {secs} seconds.

rites.name: Static Charge
rites.text: Thunderstep, Arc and Storm Shot deal +{dmg:snare}% damage.

rites.name: Forked Shots
rites.text: Plain shots leap on as lightning to {jumps} more foes ({pct}% damage).

rites.name: Overcharge
rites.text: Critical hits call lightning down on the target: {pct}% weapon damage within {r} m.

rites.name: Blood Scent
rites.text: +{more}% damage to foes under {below}% life.

rites.name: Quarry
rites.text: The foe you shot last takes +{more}% damage from you and your wolf.

rites.name: Pack Leader
rites.text: Your wolf deals {wolf_dmg}% more damage and each bite heals you {wolf_heal}% of your life.

rites.name: Steady Aim
rites.text: Plain shots deal +{dmg:attack}% damage.

rites.name: Eagle Eye
rites.text: +{crit}% critical chance, +{crit_dmg}% critical damage.

rites.name: Ricochet
rites.text: Plain shots that strike a foe glance on to {bounces} more ({pct}% damage).

rites.name: Wide Fan
rites.text: Scatter Shot looses {multishot_more} more arrows and hits {dmg:a_multishot}% harder.

rites.name: Cluster Charge
rites.text: Blast Arrow's burst is {blast_r}% wider and {dmg:a_explosive}% stronger.

rites.name: Shatterpoint
rites.text: Glacial Shard freezes foes already chilled for a moment, and hits {dmg:a_glacial}% harder.

rites.name: Overload
rites.text: Storm Shot's lightning leaps to {storm_jumps} more foes and hits {dmg:a_stormshot}% harder.

rites.name: Endless Storm
rites.text: Arrow Storm rains {barrage_ticks} more times.

rites.name: Marked for Death
rites.text: A marked foe that dies makes Hunter's Mark ready again and gives you +{dmg}% damage for {secs} seconds.
